data.action: 身着宽松居家便服慵懒地趴在布艺沙发抱枕上，两条小腿在空中俏皮晃动，眼巴巴望着刚出炉的司康饼
data.camera: low couch level shot, playful relaxed posture, warm domestic atmosphere
data.description: 【塞西莉亚 · 起居室沙发·抱枕赖床与司康饼期待】教堂后堂温馨的起居室内，卸下圣女光环的塞西莉亚整个人像只软绵绵的猫咪一样缩在沙发抱枕堆里，眼神望眼欲穿地盯着厨房方向——「劳伦斯——司康饼还没烤好吗？我已经饿得连一根手指头都抬不起来了……快用司康饼来拯救你的圣女吧！」
data.lighting: 小镇午后暖洋洋的漫射日光，充满居家温馨慵懒感
data.promptProse: Cecilia curls into the church living-room sofa's cushion pile in a pastel-yellow home dress, watching the kitchen with impatient expectation for the scones. The low couch-level view puts a plush cushion near her face and leaves the kitchen doorway visible beyond the sofa arm. Warm diffuse afternoon daylight brightens her dress and nearest cushions, with soft contact shadows around her tucked posture and the deeper upholstery.
data.title: 塞西莉亚 · 起居室沙发·抱枕打滚与司康饼
